required_action: Review rows with the standard facility-specific rules.
reason: Rows are positive evidence if they pass review rules.

evidence_condition: primary endpoint returns zero and fallback endpoint completes zero
required_action: Record endpoint names and completed zero-row status.
reason: Completed independent zeroes can support bounded absence.

evidence_condition: primary endpoint returns zero and fallback endpoint returns rows
required_action: Use fallback rows and mark source note.
reason: Illinois post-office showed alternate Overpass zeroes can be false.

evidence_condition: primary endpoint times out and fallback endpoint returns rows
required_action: Use fallback rows and mark source note.
reason: A timeout is not absence; completed positive fallback evidence resolves the gate.

evidence_condition: primary endpoint times out and fallback endpoint completes zero
required_action: Record timeout plus completed fallback zero.
reason: Absence is bounded to the completed fallback geometry only.

evidence_condition: primary endpoint returns zero and fallback endpoint hits API limit
required_action: Do not classify as checked absent.
reason: Contradictory or incomplete source access cannot support absence.

evidence_condition: all endpoints time out or hit API limits
required_action: Defer target or use an approved new source path.
reason: No absence claim can be made without a completed source pass.

evidence_condition: food_service broad query times out but narrow/local source returns rows
required_action: Use reviewed positive rows and keep broad-query note.
reason: Positive food-service evidence is enough to block postal-only classification.

evidence_condition: food_service broad query times out and only one endpoint returns zero
required_action: Retry with independent source path before classifying.
reason: Washington and Illinois showed single-path zeroes are not reliable enough.

evidence_condition: dense target box exceeds OSM map API limits
status_assignment: source_gated or subdivide in new version
required_action: Do not silently shrink the box inside the same output version.
reason: Changing geometry changes the claim boundary.
